subject: Trading
title: The Dollar Smile Theory
description: Learn The Dollar Smile Theory in one minute.

hook.text: The dollar strengthens when the US economy booms AND when the global economy crashes. It weakens in between.

buildup.text: Stephen Jen's Dollar Smile theory explains this U-shape: strength at both extremes, weakness in the middle.

discovery.text: In booms, high US growth attracts capital. In crises, safe-haven demand pulls money into dollars.

twist.text: When things are just okay—moderate growth, low volatility—investors seek higher yields elsewhere and sell dollars.

climax.text: The Dollar Smile explains why the dollar defies simple logic—it benefits from opposite economic scenarios.

punchline.text: The dollar wins when things go very well or very badly.

quiz.question: According to the Dollar Smile theory, when does the dollar weaken?
options: During moderate global growth with low volatility
